IGUI_MBLD_Catalog_Wait: Cataloging tiles. You can search what is done so far.

IGUI_MBLD_Empty_QueryHint: Try a shorter word, or switch to All sources and the All tab.
IGUI_MBLD_Empty_Fav: No favorites yet. Select an item and press Add to favorites (gamepad: Y).
IGUI_MBLD_Empty_Recent: Nothing used yet in this game. Items you press Build on show up here.
IGUI_MBLD_Empty_Only: You lack materials or tools for everything here. Turn off Only what I can build to see all.
IGUI_MBLD_Empty_None: Nothing on this tab matches. Set the source to All sources, or pick another tab.
IGUI_MBLD_Tip_Short: missing materials or tools, select it to see the list
IGUI_MBLD_Detail_Gone: Can no longer be built here. The admin may have turned off its kind or source. Pick another item.
IGUI_MBLD_Detail_WindowLocked: Permanently locked: this window can't be opened, but it can be smashed.
IGUI_MBLD_Refund_pickup: Removal: pick it up as usual (it can be moved).
IGUI_MBLD_Refund_scrap: Removal: vanilla dismantle, returns part of the materials.
IGUI_MBLD_Refund_builder: Removal: right-click "Dismantle (Build Anything)", which returns between 1 and all of each material.
IGUI_MBLD_Refund_none: Removal: only by smashing with a sledgehammer. No materials back.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_stairs: All three steps need a floor under them. A landing floor is added on the level above if there is none.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_roof: Keeps rain out. For the room to count as indoors (temperature), the level above also needs a floor. PgUp/PgDn changes the level; drag a row from the supported end.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_roofOpen: This piece does not keep rain out (eaves, decoration); the square below stays outdoors. PgUp/PgDn changes the level; drag a row from the supported end.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_light: Lights up only with power: self-built houses are not on the grid, so use a generator. A switch you place wires itself to the lights in the same closed room; right-click it and choose Wiring... to add or remove lights.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_lightStreet: Lights up only at night, and only with power: self-built houses are not on the grid, so use a generator. A switch you place wires itself to the lights in the same closed room; right-click it and choose Wiring... to add or remove lights.
IGUI_MBLD_WhatsNew: Sinks, toilets and bathtubs you build get water from a rain collector one floor up once plumbed.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_curtain: Hangs on the indoor side of a window frame. The square needs a roof or a floor above it.
IGUI_MBLD_Note_plumb: No running water, just like a fixture you pick up and move. Plumb it inside a closed room with a pipe wrench; it then draws water from a rain collector barrel or other water container one floor up, right above it or one square around.
IGUI_MBLD_DragShort: %1 tiles lack materials; together they still need %2
IGUI_MBLD_DragShortOne: 1 tile lacks materials; it still needs %2
IGUI_MBLD_Replace: This cancels the %1 tiles still queued from your last row
IGUI_MBLD_ReplaceOne: This cancels the 1 tile still queued from your last row

IGUI_MBLD_Why_Title: "%1" is a game tile, but Build Anything doesn't list it

IGUI_MBLD_Why_CURTAIN_CLOSED: This is a curtain shown closed. Search for the open one instead.

IGUI_MBLD_Why_NO_KIND: It has no property that tells what kind of thing it is (wall, floor, furniture...).
